ModMetaData.name: Occupation & Annexation
ModMetaData.author: Devloner
ModMetaData.description:
Enemy settlements no longer have to be wiped out. Break their defense and the survivors capitulate: they drop their weapons and lie face down. Occupy the town, win its loyalty, annex it into your Protectorate, collect what it produces and visit it.
Capitulation - Defender morale breaks from losses, destroyed turrets, a fallen commander, suppression (Combat Extended) and being outnumbered. - Those who surrendered are no threat. Right-click one to take them prisoner. - When the shooting stops, their medics carry the wounded into beds and tend them. Shoot at them and they lie back down. Anyone on fire is put out first. - Your doctors can tend them too, and the town will remember it. Killing them upsets your colonists (according to their ideoligion) and costs goodwill with other factions.
Towns - Occupied towns grow loyal over time, faster with a garrison, low taxes and gifts. Annex them once they are ready. - Towns produce goods from their workshops and fields; build more during a visit to change what they make. - Take goods by caravan, or have them delivered by pack animals or drop pods. - Visit a town: it is rebuilt as you left it, and the locals work, repair, patrol and sleep on a daily routine. - Loyal towns attract newcomers until their beds are full; annexed towns send volunteers to your colony. - Train a militia against the former owners' attempts to retake the town. Disloyal towns may rise up.
Requires Harmony. Optional support for Combat Extended and CAI 5000. Safe to add to an existing save; not safe to remove. English and Ukrainian.
This mod was created using an LLM, so please keep that in mind if you use it.
